title: hello frame (server -> client, on connect and on resync)
description: R7 town: snapshot = the day the state and deltas start from and the world's generation (epoch 2 = the town); town = the static geometry; state + deltas = the live town. Generated by `relay dump-hello`, never by hand.

build.description: R8: the relay's www build id (the /v/<build>/ prefix). A page whose own build differs reloads once (main.js). Absent from dev dumps.

started.description: R9: the town's first day (the page's turn counter); absent memory-only

state.description: Live state a reload must not lose, persisted with the snapshot: firing alerts, health, replicas, builds in flight, visitor marks, the town's plots, quorum. It changes only through frames (relay State.apply, mirrored by world.js).

builds.description: app -> build in flight (ev build queued|running; success|failure removes it)

marks.description: W4: the active visitor marks, world:mark payloads (never gone), oldest first; a new one beyond 2000 drops the oldest, gone removes its id.

plots.description: R7: the town buildings, world:plot payloads, one per app (a frame replaces it; gone removes it), ≤ 64.

quorum.description: R7.1: the hosts whose Proxmox node is in quorum (ev quorum up[]); null or absent = not known yet (a snapshot from before R7.1).

machines.description: R8: probed machine -> up|down (ev machine, shown only after holding 10 min); a machine absent here is not known yet. Absent = a snapshot from before R8 deploy B.

annexes.description: R8 C: the tents, world:annex payloads, one per app@host (a frame replaces it; gone removes it), ≤ 48. Absent = a snapshot from before R8 deploy C.

tech.description: R9: infra-bootstrap's ADRs as numbers only (ev tech): how many, the highest number.

calm.description: R9: the day since which no warning or critical Alertmanager alert fires and no app is Degraded or Missing; empty = not calm.

town.description: R7/R8: the static town geometry (relay/town): islands h1..h3, each with its own radius (R8: sized by its host's hardware), global axial centre q, r, and tiles = one kind per local hex in canonical order (r ascending, then q; s square, g grass, r road, b bridge head, m meadow; 3·radius·(radius+1)+1 of them), and the bridges between their heads.
